events.title: [code + business: needs legal review] Non-custodial on-chain bounty escrow
events.body:
**Roadmap Phase 6.** ForkMesh currently custodies bounty SOL in per-issue deposit keys — a money-transmission exposure and a honeypot. Move escrow on-chain so ForkMesh never holds user funds.

- Solana program (Anchor: <https://www.anchor-lang.com>): funder deposits into a PDA bound to (repo root commit, issue number); release splits 90/10 to contributor and project when the repo owner's node submits a merge attestation signed with the same Ed25519 key the mesh already trusts; refund path to the funder after expiry.
- Client keeps the same UX (`MainWindowIssues.cpp` bounty controls); only the destination and release mechanics change.
- Ship devnet first. Do #367 first — it validates the payout semantics we then freeze into the program.
- Business (not code, hence the title tag): legal review of whether attestation-gated escrow still creates transmitter obligations, **before** mainnet deploy.
